name: Dungeon Finder locks specific Mythic dungeons until the Mythic Dungeons release stage
contract: The client lists Random Mythic dungeons only after the server sends the Mythic difficulty game events, which
happens from release stage 2 (Mythic Dungeons, Ascension.CallboardCache.ReleaseStage or .raidphase). Its
Specific Dungeons list still shows every Mythic dungeon, and LFGMgr::InitializeLockedDungeons did not read the
release stage, so a player queued a specific Mythic dungeon before Mythic was released. Below stage 2 each
Mythic (difficulty 2) dungeon entry must carry LFG_LOCKSTATUS_NOT_IN_SEASON (1031), which the client shows as
the generic requirements tooltip, and a join for Vaults of the Inquisition Mythic (2401) must be refused.
Heroic (1401) stays open from stage 1, and at stage 2 the Mythic entry is unlocked and the same join queues.
A .raidphase change rebuilds the online players' locks.

steps.label: SETUP: the realm is at the Mythic Dungeons release stage
CONTROL: at stage 2 Vaults of the Inquisition Mythic is open
SETUP: the realm goes back to the Heroic Dungeons release stage
at stage 1 Vaults of the Inquisition Mythic is locked
CONTROL: at stage 1 Vaults of the Inquisition Heroic stays open
the player picks Vaults of the Inquisition Mythic as a specific dungeon
at stage 1 the specific Mythic join is refused
at stage 1 the Mythic dungeon is not selected
SETUP: the realm releases Mythic Dungeons
at stage 2 Vaults of the Inquisition Mythic is unlocked again
CONTROL: the same specific Mythic join at stage 2
CONTROL: at stage 2 the specific Mythic join queues
CONTROL: at stage 2 the Mythic dungeon is selected
